title: Flutter Bench results payload
description:
Contract for the benchmark file committed to the flutter.dev repository and built into the Flutter Bench leaderboard (/flutterbench). There is no runtime server: this file IS the data source, reviewed once and then frozen.

It carries two layers. (1) PRECOMPUTED METRICS, under every `metrics` key: these are the exact values the site renders, so the numbers published are the numbers that were reviewed, and an archived snapshot cannot be silently restated by a later code change. (2) RAW MEASUREMENTS, under every `trials` key: the per-trial observations the metrics were derived from, committed alongside so reviewers can audit the rollups in the same diff and so future metrics can be derived without re-running the suite.

Core invariant: every value under a `metrics` key is a pure function of that scope's `trials` plus `snapshot.scoring`. Nothing else is derived. CI re-derives all of them and fails on disagreement, so the two layers cannot drift. See SCHEMA-flutterbench.md.

Scale rule, applied without exception: raw trial scores are 0.0-1.0; every precomputed score, rate, and standard deviation is a percentage, 0-100.

schemaVersion.description: Version of THIS schema the payload conforms to. 2.x carries precomputed metrics; 1.x carried raw trials only and left all arithmetic to the UI.

runs.description: One entry per (agent, model, variant) combination. The site pairs the `baseline` and `ai_tooling` runs of the same agent+model into a single leaderboard row, so both variants of a model should be present whenever both were evaluated.
runs.$comment: Baseline-vs-tooling deltas are deliberately NOT precomputed. They belong to a row pairing this file does not model, and subtracting two already-reviewed numbers cannot drift the way a weighted mean can. The UI computes them.

snapshot.title: Snapshot metadata
snapshot.description: Identifies this publication of the leaderboard and records how its numbers were produced. Drives the current-vs-archive split at /flutterbench and /flutterbench/archive.

id.description: Stable, URL-safe identifier for this snapshot. Never reused or rewritten once published.

label.description: Human-readable snapshot name shown in the UI.

generatedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp (UTC) at which this payload was produced.

status.description: `current` renders on /flutterbench; `archived` renders on /flutterbench/archive. Exactly one published snapshot should be `current`.

trialsPerTask.description: K: the number of independent trials run per task. Labels the Pass@K column, and every task in every run must carry exactly this many trials.

environment.description: Versions the suite ran against. Optional but strongly recommended: without it, archived snapshots cannot be compared honestly, since a Flutter or harness upgrade alone can move scores.

suiteVersion.description: Version of the CUJ task set. Changing the task set must change this.

harnessVersion.description: Version of the Flutter AI tooling / MCP harness used by the `ai_tooling` variant.

notes.description: Free-text caveat shown with the snapshot (e.g. a roster or methodology change).

scoring.title: Scoring parameters
scoring.description: The constants this snapshot's metrics were computed with, recorded so each archived snapshot stays self-describing. A future methodology revision changes these values in new snapshots and leaves published ones untouched; the UI never needs to know historical weights. CI uses these values (not hardcoded ones) when re-deriving metrics.

outcomeWeight.description: Weight of `outcome` in Result Score. The three weights must sum to exactly 1.0 — JSON Schema cannot express that, so the producer must enforce it.

passThreshold.description: Minimum `trial.outcome` that counts as a pass. 1.0 means only a fully clean run passes; both Pass Rate and Pass@K are built on this threshold.

agentId.description: Stable key for the agent, independent of display name, so a product rename does not split one agent's history across snapshots. The site keys rows and filters on this.

agent.description: Agent display name, as shown in the Agent filter and the leaderboard row.

modelId.description: Stable model key, independent of display name. Use the provider's API model id where one exists.

model.description: Model display name, as shown in the Model filter and the leaderboard row.

modelProvider.description: Organization serving the model. Optional; useful for grouping when one agent runs models from several providers.

variant.description: Which configuration was evaluated: `baseline` is the model with no Flutter-specific tooling; `ai_tooling` is the same model equipped with the official Flutter harness. The three-state toggle (Baseline / With AI tooling / Both) and all delta indicators depend on these two values.

startedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when this run began. Optional.

completedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when this run finished. Optional.

tasks.description: One entry per CUJ evaluated in this run. Every run in a snapshot must cover the same task ids, or rows are not comparable.
tasks.$comment: Task ids must be unique within a run — JSON Schema cannot express that, so the producer must enforce it.

notes.description: Free-text caveat for this run (e.g. a provider rate limit that truncated a task).

runMetrics.title: Precomputed run-level metrics
runMetrics.description: Exactly the values the leaderboard table and the detail drawer's overview cards render. Derived from this run's `tasks[].metrics`, which are in turn derived from `tasks[].trials`. All rates and scores are percentages, 0-100.

totalTasks.description: Number of tasks in this run — the denominator of `passRate` and `passAtKRate`.

passedTaskCount.description: Tasks where EVERY trial passed (`metrics.passedAllTrials`). Published as a count as well as a rate so a reviewer can verify the percentage by eye.

passAtKTaskCount.description: Tasks where AT LEAST ONE trial passed (`metrics.passedAnyTrial`).

passAtKRate.description: passAtKTaskCount / totalTasks x 100. Rendered as 'Pass@K' with K from `snapshot.trialsPerTask`.

scoreSd.description: SAMPLE standard deviation (n-1 denominator) of this run's `tasks[].metrics.resultScore`; 0 when totalTasks is 1. Rendered as the '± x.x%' beside Avg Score.

avgOutcome.description: Mean of `tasks[].metrics.outcome`. Note this is the mean of the raw component, NOT weighted by `scoring.outcomeWeight` — the weighting is applied in resultScore only.

avgTokens.description: Mean of `tasks[].metrics.meanTokens`, rounded to the nearest integer. Tokens per task run, not per run total.

avgCost.description: Mean of `tasks[].metrics.meanCost`, in USD. Cost per task run, not per run total.

task.title: One CUJ (critical user journey) within a run

id.description: Stable task identifier, shared across every run and snapshot that evaluates this CUJ.

name.description: Task display name, shown in the detail drawer's per-task table.

category.description: Task horizon. `short_horizon` tasks are single-file, single-concern fixes; `long_horizon` tasks span multiple files, packages, or external services.

trials.description: The K independent executions of this task. Length must equal `snapshot.trialsPerTask`.
trials.$comment: trialIndex values must be unique and cover 1..K — JSON Schema cannot express that, so the producer must enforce it.

taskMetrics.title: Precomputed task-level metrics
taskMetrics.description: Exactly the values the detail drawer's per-task table renders, derived from this task's `trials` and `snapshot.scoring`. Scores are percentages, 0-100.

resultScore.description: (meanOutcome x outcomeWeight + meanQuality x qualityWeight + meanDx x dxWeight) x 100, using the trial means on the 0-1 scale and the weights from `snapshot.scoring`.

passedAllTrials.description: passedTrialCount == snapshot.trialsPerTask. Feeds the run's Pass Rate.

meanTokens.description: Mean of `trials[].tokens`, rounded to the nearest integer: tokens for one typical attempt at this task, not the sum across K attempts.

meanCost.description: Mean of `trials[].cost`, in USD, on the same per-trial basis as meanTokens.

trial.title: One trial execution (raw measurement)
trial.description: The observed result of a single attempt. These are the only numbers in the file that are measured rather than derived, and the sole input to every `metrics` block. The three graded scores are on a 0.0-1.0 scale.

trialIndex.description: 1-based index of this trial within the task.

outcome.description: Code-graded correctness. Meeting `snapshot.scoring.passThreshold` (1.0: every automated assertion passed with zero runtime errors) is the atomic pass condition for both Pass Rate and Pass@K; anything below it is a failure, however partial. Send fractional values only where the rubric defines partial credit.

quality.description: Model-graded code quality against the human-authored golden solution (idiomatic API use, structure, lints).

dx.description: Developer-experience score: how workable the agent's process was (turn count, false starts, clarity of its reporting).

tokens.description: Total tokens consumed by this trial (input + output, summed across the agent's turns). Required in 2.x: it is what makes the published token figures auditable, since `meanTokens` must equal the mean of these.

cost.description: USD cost of this trial at billed provider pricing when it ran, not list price at publication time.

status.description: Why a trial scored as it did, distinguishing a genuine failure from an infrastructure problem. Optional and not rendered today, but if the distinction exists upstream, send it: whether an `error` or `timeout` trial should count against Pass Rate is a methodology decision, and the data has to carry the distinction for that decision to be available at all.

durationSeconds.description: Wall-clock duration of this trial. Optional; not rendered today.
